tools.name: create-post
tools.title: Create Post
tools.description: Create a new social media post on OmniSocials. Provide content text and optionally specify target accounts, schedule time, and media URLs. Supports Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, and Mastodon.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.title: List Posts
tools.description: List social media posts from OmniSocials. Filter by status: draft, scheduled, posted, or failed.

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.title: List Accounts
tools.description: List connected social media accounts on OmniSocials.

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.title: Get Analytics
tools.description: Get social media analytics overview from OmniSocials for a given time period (7d, 30d, or 90d).

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your OmniSocials API key. Get it at app.omnisocials.com > Settings > API. For multiple workspaces, use the Manage Workspaces command instead.
